description_en: Updates the enabled status of a swimming lane
kebab_example: aliyun sae update-swimming-lane-enable-attribute --namespace-id cn-beijing:test --group-id 2074 --lane-id 9637 --enable true --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateSwimmingLaneEnableAttribute

false: disabled
